title: Visits, Term and Grace Days by Plan Level — KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
Each KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans level prepays a fixed number of service visits that can be used for a set number of months and a set number of miles. The term sheet below gives those figures for every level.

## Term sheet

| Plan level | Prepaid visits included | Term (months) | Term (miles added to the odometer at sale) | Plan sold with the vehicle starts on the handover date | Grace days after the expiration date | Unused visits forfeited at expiry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | 2 | 12 | 10000 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | 3 | 18 | 15000 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 4 | 24 | 20000 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | 6 | 36 | 30000 | Yes | 7 | Yes |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | 8 | 48 | 40000 | Yes | 7 | Yes |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 10 | 60 | 50000 | Yes | 14 | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Prepaid visits included** — the service visits in the plan, as a whole number of visits.
- **Term (months)** — the months during which visits can be used.
- **Term (miles)** — the miles added to the odometer reading at sale, after which visits can no longer be used.
- **Starts on the handover date** — "Yes" means a plan sold with the vehicle starts on the vehicle's handover date rather than on the plan's sale date.
- **Grace days** — calendar days after the expiration date during which a visit booked before expiry can still be redeemed. A grace figure of 0 means there are no such days for that level.
- **Unused visits forfeited at expiry** — "Yes" means visits left unused when the plan expires are forfeited.

## Reading the term sheet

**Which levels have grace days?** KestrelCare Maintenance Plus and KestrelCare Maintenance Premier have 7 grace days; KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max has 14; KestrelCare Maintenance Starter, Basic and Standard have 0.

**Are the mileage and month terms separate figures?** Yes. Each level states a term in months and a term in miles; a Starter plan, for example, has a 12-month term and a term of 10000 miles, and a Premier Max plan a 60-month term and a term of 50000 miles.

**Hypothetical reading.** A KestrelCare Maintenance Plus plan sold with a vehicle (an example only) carries 6 visits, a 36-month term, a term of 30000 miles added to its odometer reading at sale, and 7 grace days after its expiration date for a visit booked before expiry.
